name: International Biology Olympiad
desc: The International Biology Olympiad (IBO) is a global competition for pre-university students under the age of 20, held annually since 1990. It features theoretical and practical exam components, with practicals often split across several biology sub-disciplines (biochemistry, molecular biology, plant and animal anatomy, ecology, bioinformatics, and more). This archive contains publicly shared problem and solution PDFs from past IBO editions, sourced from the official IBO archive.
summary: International biology olympiad for pre-university students, featuring theoretical and practical exam rounds.

name: All Russian Astronomy Olympiad
desc: The All Russian Astronomy Olympiad (ARAO) is a national competition for students in Russia. The competition tests theoretical knowledge, observational skills, and problem-solving abilities in astronomy and astrophysics.
summary: National astronomy olympiad for students in Russia.

name: AO Guide Astrophysics Challenge
desc: The AO Guide Astrophysics Challenge (AOAC) is an international astronomy competition that tests students' knowledge in observational and theoretical astronomy. The competition consists of two main divisions: Open and Invitational. The Open division is accessible to all students worldwide, while the Invitational division is for top performers and features more challenging problems. AOAC emphasizes practical astronomy skills including data analysis, celestial mechanics, and astrophysics.
summary: International online astronomy competition testing observational and theoretical knowledge.
